Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding uniform television energy efficiency standards.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the energy efficiency code; and adding a newsection to chapter 19.260 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 19.260 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department shall monitor television energy efficiency standardsproposed in California and Oregon. After either state adopts proposedstandards and the department determines that uniform standards amongwest coast states would promote consistency and provide marketinfluence in achieving greater energy efficiency, the department shall,by December 1st of the year in which it makes the determination,provide recommendations regarding adoption of television energyefficiency standards to the appropriate committees of the legislature.
